parsed.explanation: No documented trans-specific criminal offence, facility exclusion, custody placement rule or border requirement now. Recent decriminalisation and a constitutional equality ruling (though sexual-orientation focused) are traveler-relevant climate positives; courts convicted an attacker. But the attack record is dated and punishment was light, social/religious hostility and official questioning of LGBT migration are real, and trans-specific protections/service/border practice are undocumented. Absence of evidence is not safety, and resident-only gaps (employment, LGR) are not direct deductions. Consequences if outed are chiefly social friction, possible discrimination and uncertain recourse rather than prosecution, placing it just above elevated risk due to thin evidence of protective machinery.
